title: Spanish Kissed Ceviche
description: A refreshing Spanish-inspired ceviche dish kissed with love and perfect for a light dinner or snack.

ingredients.name: Fresh tilapia fillets
ingredients.notes: Ask your fishmonger for sustainable options

ingredients.name: Kissed Spanish red onion
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice and soak in lime juice for 30 minutes

ingredients.name: Ceviche seasoning
ingredients.notes: Mix of garlic, oregano, and smoked paprika

instructions: 1. Cut the tilapia into small pieces and place in a large bowl.
2. In a separate bowl, whisk together ceviche seasoning, lime juice, and Spanish olive oil.
3. Pour the marinade over the tilapia and toss to coat.
4. Add the kissed Spanish red onion to the bowl and toss to combine.
5. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
6. Just before serving, garnish with chopped cilantro.
7. Serve chilled, with tortilla chips or toasted bread on the side.
8. Enjoy as a light and refreshing snack or lunch.
